items.title: Pursuit Announces First Major Organic Growth Investment at Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa
items.summary: Three premium rainforest villas represent the first expansion since Pursuit acquired Tabacón in 2025, advancing the company's Vision 2030 growth strategy Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) today announced plans to develop three premium guest accommodation villas at Tabacón Thermal Resort Spa, representing the first major organic growth investment at Tabacón since acquiring the award-winning Costa Rican resort in July 2025. The expansion reflects Pursuit's Vision 2030 strategy of creating long-term shareholder value through disciplined organic growth investments that enhance market-leading guest experiences, alongside strategic acquisitions in iconic destinations. Located within Tabacón’s existing 570-acre resort property, the villas will help guests experience the resort at a deeper level and connect to Costa Rica's largest network of naturally flowing thermal springs, adjacent to the Arenal Volcano National Park protected rainforest reserve. items.title: Pursuit Completes Strategic Divestiture of Flyover Business, Strengthening Focus on Growth in Iconic Destinations
items.summary: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit”) (NYSE: PRSU) today announced that it has completed the sale of its Flyover flying theater attraction business (“Flyover”) to Brogent Technologies Inc. for $75 million, subject to customary purchase price adjustments, representing a multiple of approximately 14.5 times Flyover’s 2025 Adjusted EBITDA contribution. items.title: Pursuit Expands into One of Canada's Leading Tourism Destinations with Eagle Wing Tours Acquisition
items.summary: Victoria-based marine wildlife experience enters next chapter of growth with continued local leadership, conservation focus and commitment to regenerative tourism Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) today announced it has acquired Eagle Wing Tours, a Victoria, British Columbia-based whale watching and marine wildlife experience, expanding its portfolio into one of Canada's most visited and resilient tourism destinations and advancing its strategy of investing in iconic experiences in markets with strong long-term demand. The acquisition marks Pursuit's entry into the Vancouver Island market, a globally recognized destination known for its marine wildlife, natural beauty, vibrant communities and year-round visitor appeal. Victoria welcomes nearly five million visitors annually, highlighting the strength of the region’s visitor economy. items.title: Pursuit Reveals Hotel Whitefish, the Next Chapter of Grouse Mountain Lodge
items.summary: Enhanced South Wing guestrooms welcome guests now; pool, sauna and hot tub updates arriving this summer and new 8,250-square-foot event center opens Fall 2026; and reimagined dining, lobby, guest spaces and remaining guestrooms debut with the full hotel experience in 2027 Pursuit today unveiled Hotel Whitefish, a significant, multi-million-dollar reinvestment in Grouse Mountain Lodge that will introduce a refreshed stay, event and gathering experience in one of Montana's best-known mountain destinations. This project is part of Pursuit's broader plan to deploy more than $300 million into growth projects across its portfolio by 2030. Rolling out in phases, the transformation includes 72 refreshed South Wing guestrooms now open, pool and hot tub upgrades arriving this summer, a new 8,250-square-foot Event Pavilion opening in Fall 2026, and reimagined dining, shared spaces and additional guest rooms as part of the full Hotel Whitefish launch in Summer 2027. items.title: Pursuit Launches World’s First Electric Ice Explorer in Jasper National Park
items.summary: Canadian-built vehicle reduces emissions and offers a quieter, more immersive way for guests to experience the Athabasca Glacier as part of the Columbia Icefield Adventure Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (Pursuit) (NYSE: PRSU) today launched the world’s first electric Ice Explorer as part of the Columbia Icefield Adventure in Jasper National Park, Alberta, marking a thoughtful evolution in how guests experience one of the world’s most iconic and sensitive landscapes, the Athabasca Glacier. The vehicle is now operating as part of the regular fleet on the Athabasca Glacier, charging through onboard bifacial solar panels and regenerative braking. The pilot launches at a moment when Canada’s national parks are increasingly focused on how tourism can provide access while exercising environmental responsibility.
